title: Perfect projection comparison for fixed data
statement: For fixed data from the parent node, the projection comparison is invertible for every perfect complex.

proof.text: Use perfect_tensor_hom_duality on Y to obtain both exact pairings K,D and D,K. Map the first pairing by the given strong monoidal pullback.

Conjugate commTensorLeft at the dual under the composite tensor-left and pullback adjunctions. Mathlib conjugation preserves isomorphisms; monoidal_projection_conjugate identifies its components with the specified canonical projection map. Construct pfK and the projection isomorphism for D and every E as the inverses of these components.

For every quasi-coherent E compose full-subcategory Hom equivalences, pulled tensor duality, adj.symm, projection for D, tensor duality on Y, the right unitor and adj. The new tensor-Hom counit comparison identifies this explicitly written equivalence with postcomposition by the required mate. Its bijectivity and Yoneda imply IsIso.

proof_origin.place: Tag 0A9T; Y2 categorical reduction via duality and conjugate adjunctions

theorem smoothProper_tensor_perfect_case_core
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian X] [IsNoetherian Y] (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsProper f]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ U : Y.Opens,
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u}
        ((moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace).over U))]
    (hRf : ∀ E : schemeDerivedQCohCategory X,
      schemeDerivedQCohProperty Y ((schemeDerivedDirectImage f).obj E.obj))
    (hO : schemeDerivedQCohProperty Y (𝟙_ (schemeDerivedCategory Y)))
    (hTensor : ∀ (K : schemeDerivedQCohCategory Y)
      (E : schemeDerivedQCohCategory X),
      schemeDerivedQCohProperty X (((derivedPullback f).obj K.obj) ⊗ E.obj)) :
        ∀ (_ : Functor.Monoidal (derivedPullback f))
        (a : derivedPullback f ⊣ schemeDerivedDirectImage f)
        (c : schemeDerivedQCohCategory Y ⥤ schemeDerivedQCohCategory X)
        (adj : (schemeDerivedQCohProperty Y).lift
          ((schemeDerivedQCohProperty X).ι ⋙ schemeDerivedDirectImage f) hRf ⊣ c)
        (K : schemeDerivedQCohCategory Y), Scheme.IsPerfect Y K.obj →
        ∃ pf : (schemeDerivedDirectImage f).obj
            (((derivedPullback f).obj K.obj) ⊗ (c.obj ⟨𝟙_ _, hO⟩).obj) ≅
          K.obj ⊗ (schemeDerivedDirectImage f).obj (c.obj ⟨𝟙_ _, hO⟩).obj,
          pf.inv = (a.homEquiv _ _)
            ((Functor.Monoidal.μIso (derivedPullback f) K.obj
              ((schemeDerivedDirectImage f).obj (c.obj ⟨𝟙_ _, hO⟩).obj)).inv ≫
              (derivedPullback f).obj K.obj ◁ a.counit.app (c.obj ⟨𝟙_ _, hO⟩).obj) ∧
          IsIso ((adj.homEquiv
            ⟨((derivedPullback f).obj K.obj) ⊗ (c.obj ⟨𝟙_ _, hO⟩).obj,
              hTensor K (c.obj ⟨𝟙_ _, hO⟩)⟩ K)
            (ObjectProperty.homMk (pf.hom ≫
              K.obj ◁ (adj.counit.app ⟨𝟙_ _, hO⟩).hom ≫ (ρ_ K.obj).hom)))
